five_args.old_text:
import pygame

# Constants
SCREEN_WIDTH = 640
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 480
FPS = 60

# Colors
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
RED = (255, 0, 0)

# Initialize pygame
pygame.init()

# Set up the display
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("Spaceship Game")

# Set up the clock
clock = pygame.clock()

# Game variables
player_x = SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
player_y = SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2
player_speed = 5

# Game loop
running = True
while running:
    # Handle events
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                running = False

    # Fill the screen
    screen.fill(BLACK)

    # Draw the player (a simple rectangle for now)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, [player_x, player_y, 20, 20])

    # Update the display
    pygame.display.flip()

    # Cap the frame rate
    clock.tick(FPS)

# Quit pygame
pygame.quit()

# End of game.py
